layer_type: additive correction layer; no historical artifact rewritten
auditability_reason: The single MODERATE audit finding (F1) cannot be closed without the original per-segment score values, which do not exist. Every other finding is resolved or documented. YELLOW is the honest outcome; it does not qualify the correctness of the reproduction.

corrections.superseded_wording: The differences are of the size expected from a nondeterministic training run with patience-3 early stopping.
corrections.preferred_wording: The residual differences are consistent with plausible variation arising from the different execution environment and the upstream training procedure, including patience-based early stopping and final-epoch checkpoint aliasing.
corrections.supplementary_wording: The upstream implementation is not fully deterministic, but this single reproduction run does not estimate a run-to-run distribution.
corrections.justification: Only one reproduction run per machine exists, so no variance was measured. The run used CPU, where the cited cuDNN nondeterminism does not apply. Device, backend and torch-version differences are the genuine and sufficient explanation.

corrections.superseded_wording: The project's data path, windowing, feature construction, model and scoring are therefore consistent with the published work.
corrections.preferred_wording: Dataset handling, input construction/preprocessing, official baseline architecture and scoring are consistent with the pinned published implementation.
corrections.explicit_limit: This does NOT validate the Phase-3.1 98-engineered-feature representation. Protocol A uses per-window standardised raw multi-sensor windows; the engineered feature pipeline is not exercised anywhere in Phase 3.3.
corrections.justification: 'feature construction' named a pipeline Protocol A does not use.

corrections.superseded_wording: ...which makes MechaSight's own results comparable to the literature rather than unmoored from it.
corrections.preferred_wording: Phase 3.3 establishes a historical comparability anchor for Protocol-A-style results and independently validates the project's handling of the official IMAD-DS data path and released-split baseline.
corrections.explicit_limit: It does not by itself establish direct numerical comparability between Protocol-B results and the published Protocol-A baseline, because the protocols differ in split, preprocessing, representation and model family.
corrections.justification: A Protocol-A reproduction cannot transfer comparability to Protocol-B work.
